newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold Peak year profit up 10.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Gold Peak year profit up 10.1 percent.

text.p: Company name Gold Peak Industries (Holdings) Ltd
NOTE - Gold Peak makes and sells batteries, car audio equipment, electronic components and electrical wiring accessories.

The company proposed a bonus issue of one warrant for every five shares held. Each warrant will entitle the holder thereof to subscribe in cash at an initial subscription price of HK$5.25 (subject to adjustment) for one share at any time between the date of issue thereof to the last day of the third anniversary thereof (both dates inclusive).

Net is after an exceptional gain of HK$87.69 million arising as a result of the private placements of existing shares of subsidiaries and loss of HK$14.49 million on provision for diminution in value of interest in associated companies.
Total dividend for year is 21.5 H.K. cents (including interim dividend of nine cents) vs 19.1 cents.
